topic_title: Reduce Risk — Zero Tolerance Practices & Impairment
prompt: Why is utilizing rideshare or public transit considered the most cost-effective choice after drinking?

options.text: Rideshare companies provide free travel vouchers to licensed drivers in Texas
Taking public transit exempts drivers from paying state vehicle registration
A rideshare trip costs twenty dollars, while a Texas DWI conviction costs over $10,000
Rideshares eliminate all wear-and-tear depreciation on municipal roadway lanes
